initialization: Fresh zero-output adapters on unhealed stock or identical frozen shared-broad projection. No parent adapter or optimizer state. Nested random A directions within each architecture.
optimizer: fresh AdamW betas=(0.9,0.95), weight_decay=0, clip=1; no warmup
primary_endpoint: Fixed step 8, compare paired correctness gains from step 0 and stock-minus-projected gaps separately by rank. No best-checkpoint selection.
capacity_interaction: (projected64_final - projected16_final) - (stock64_final - stock16_final); positive means rank benefits projection more on that metric, conditional on this budget.

eval_precision: CPU FP32, four threads, greedy nonthinking, no repetition penalties

limitations: Single seed, short fixed-token pilot, no claim of irrecoverable damage from a negative result.
